item.title: Where to Order Pancit & Party Trays for Your Holiday Feast
item.description: Pancit has become a holiday staple in the Philippines not just for its taste, but for its meaning. It embodies the Filipino spirit of salu-salo (gathering together), while carrying wishes of long life and prosperity into the new year. That’s why, alongside lechon and ham, pancit almost always finds its way onto the Christmas and New Year’s table.
